id: title:Gilbert09:stop reporting delta watermark fd exhaustion as a bug

review.posthog_relevance: Adds transient error classification for warehouse ingestion worker failures caused by file-descriptor exhaustion, allowing the ingestion pipeline to distinguish this transient infrastructure blip from genuine bugs or other transient errors.
review.reason: Adds errno import and a new helper function to classify file-descriptor exhaustion errors, updates transient maintenance error classification, and adds a test case. This is a substantive, bounded correctness and reliability improvement for warehouse ingestion, distinguishing a transient infrastructure condition from permanent failure.
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the warehouse ingestion worker actually encountering this specific error and the classification being used to prevent unnecessary permanent failure handling; no production incident or adoption is observed.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No adoption, incident, or effort claims are supported. No tier assigned.
